name: StageKitWP - Import-Export
author: StageKitWP
short_description: Import and export CPT data, plugin settings, and theme customisations across the StageKitWP ecosystem.

sections.description: The import/export plugin packages selected modules into ZIP or JSON bundles and can import them back with conflict handling, remapping, and queued processing.
sections.installation: Upload the stagekitwp-import-export plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/, activate it, and open TM I/O in the admin menu.
sections.changelog: 2.1.0: added a Pages module, auto-resolved page-ID remaps, fixed a media-remap bug that could corrupt show/season/venue links, fixed same-site media re-import duplicating attachments, and exports now pack only the original media file. See CHANGELOG.md for details.
